// Playback session repository (PRD §11, §12, §44).
import { toIso } from "../map.js";
/** Create the session if absent; idempotent so ad-decision can ensure it exists.
 * If the session already exists, update its channel to reflect the channel it was
 * most recently associated with (a session can legitimately continue under a
 * different channel than the one it started on). */
export async function ensureSession(db, input) {
    await db.query(`INSERT INTO playback_sessions (id, channel_id, device_type, country, anonymous_id, ip_hash, user_agent)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
     ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET channel_id = EXCLUDED.channel_id`, [
        input.id,
        input.channelId,
        input.deviceType ?? null,
        input.country ?? null,
        input.anonymousId ?? null,
        input.ipHash ?? null,
        input.userAgent ?? null,
    ]);
}
export async function touchSession(db, id) {
    await db.query("UPDATE playback_sessions SET last_activity_at = now() WHERE id = $1", [id]);
}
function toSession(r) {
    return {
        id: r.id,
        channelId: r.channel_id,
        createdAt: toIso(r.created_at),
        lastActivityAt: toIso(r.last_activity_at),
        deviceType: r.device_type,
        country: r.country,
        anonymousId: r.anonymous_id,
    };
}
export async function getSession(db, id) {
    const rows = (await db.query("SELECT * FROM playback_sessions WHERE id = $1", [id])).rows;
    return rows[0] ? toSession(rows[0]) : null;
}
export async function listSessions(db, limit = 100) {
    const rows = (await db.query("SELECT * FROM playback_sessions ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC LIMIT $1", [limit])).rows;
    return rows.map(toSession);
}
//# sourceMappingURL=sessions.js.map53f0dc87b88f:/app/packages/persistence#
